title: Drop copy transition table
statement: Define a transition table on indices $0,1,\ldots,7$ whose entries are triples consisting of two indices in $\{0,\ldots,8\}$ and a drop-machine state. In order, the entries are $(8,0,\text{copy stage }1\text{ with flag false})$, $(7,1,\text{tail test with flag true})$, $(0,1,\text{decode})$, $(2,8,\text{$z$-decrement step }0)$, $(3,0,\text{copy stage }5\text{ with flag false})$, $(4,0,\text{$u$-decrement step }0)$, $(5,0,\text{clear pointer stage }3)$, and $(0,3,\text{seek with flag true})$.
